                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   SYMMETRIC CYCLOTOMIC HECKE ALGEBRAS
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Gunter Malle and Andrew Mathas
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         Universitat Heidelberg and Universitat Bielefeld
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     In this paper we prove that the generic cyclotomic Hecke algebras for imprimitive com-
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     plex reectiongroupsare symmetricoverany ringcontaininginversesof the parameters.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     For this we show that the determinant of the Gram matrix of a certain canonical sym-
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     metrizing form introduced in [3] is a unit in any such ring. On the way we show that
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     the Ariki-Koike bases of these algebras are also quasi-symmetric.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                0. Introduction and statement of the main result
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         Work of Broue, Michel and the rst author on `-blocks in nite groups of Lie
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             type suggest that the decomposition of certain Lusztig induced characters should be
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             governed by suitable complex reection groups. This lead Broue and the rst author
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             in [4] to introduce the concept of the cyclotomic Hecke algebra H(W;u) associated
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             to a complex reection group W. Conjecturally specializations of this algebra should
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             occur as endomorphism algebras of Lusztig induced characters, thus explaining the
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             aforementioned observation (see [4]).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         This general conjecture has been proved only in a small number of cases. Never-
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             theless, several structural and numerical consequences of this conjecture have been
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             veried. One of the properties of cyclotomic algebras implied by the general conjec-
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             ture is that H should carry a canonical symmetrizing form making it into a symmetric
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             algebra over the ground ring A in which just the parameters are inverted. Such a
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             canonical symmetrizing form over the eld of fractions of A was constructed in [3]
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             for all but nitely many of the cyclotomic algebras associated to irreducible complex
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             reection groups. In this paper we prove that pairs of dual bases with respect to this
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             form are dened over A:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             Theorem. The generic cyclotomic algebra H = H(W;u) of an irreducible imprimi-
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 ␀1
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             tive complex reection group W is symmetric over Z[u;u                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ].
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         The proof of this result will be given in the subsequent sections. There we will
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             also give more precise statements about properties of the corresponding symmetrizing
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             form.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         The assertion of the main theorem is well known in the case of Iwahori-Hecke
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             algebras, i.e., for cyclotomic algebras for real reection groups. In that case a dual
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             basis can immediately be written down in terms of the standard basis of H and the

It turns out that the situation for the complex case
